test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Going to the weekly market / in every Tuesday / is a ritual that has been followed / by generations in my family.

options.text: is a ritual that has been followed

solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **in every Tuesday**

• The given sentence contains a **prepositional error** in it.
